title: Philips Hue Bridge hap_pair_setup_handler Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution… (CVE-2026-126978)
description: CVE-2026-126978 is a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the Philips Hue Bridge's HomeKit Accessory Protocol service. This flaw allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code without authentication by sending specially crafted pairing requests to the service listening on TCP port 8080. The vulnerability arises from improper validation of user-supplied data length before copying it into a fixed-length heap buffer.
